cases.question: Which 10 products had the lowest fill rates in the latest inventory snapshot?

result.sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, p.product_name, i.fill_rate FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) AND i.fill_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.fill_rate ASC LIMIT 10
